summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting a share buyback program. The company repurchased 24,334,590 Class A ordinary shares on various dates from March to May 2026, which were cancelled on June 12, 2026, at an average price of approximately USD 6.831 per share. Additionally, multiple batches of repurchased shares remain pending cancellation, totaling roughly 7.8 million shares at prices ranging from USD 6.67 to USD 7.25. The filing also notes conversion of 3,183,680 Class B shares to Class A shares. This reflects a continued capital return program to reduce outstanding shares and enhance shareholder value. Watch for the pace of future repurchases and any impact on the stock's float.
